Experiments over $k\in\{10,25,50,100,200\}$, up to $80{,}401$ nodes, $280{,}000$ static trials, and $15{,}000$ transient trials show 100\% recovery for deterministic and bounded regimes, $99.998\%$ for multi-link faults, and $99.963\%$ for heuristic regimes; non-recovered trials are explained by disconnected components or relocation failure. Re-rooting reduces average repair edges by 80--100\% versus fixed-source repair. Patched Gaussian-link Noxim replays confirm packet-complete execution and show re-rooting reduces repair edges, components, and depth. A completion-cycle audit separates repair benefit from latency: ablations confirm completion time depends on relocation, scheduling, delivery tail, and selector objective, so the paper claims edge-minimum repair rather than universal completion-cycle dominance.

</details>


### [287] [Recency/Frequency Adaptive KV Caching for Large Language Model Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21238)
*Yang Shen,Meghana Madhyastha,Robert Underwood,Bogdan Nicolae,Randal Burns*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应KV缓存管理策略，通过动态分配缓存空间给近期和频繁出现的KV块，替代传统LRU策略，在合成和真实工作负载上分别提升了最高10.8%和2.1%的缓存命中率，并降低了TTFT延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推理中的KV缓存管理采用LRU策略，导致多个不相关的工作负载相互冲刷对方的缓存，缓存效率低下。

Method: 提出自适应缓存策略，动态地在近期出现（recency）和频繁出现（frequency）的KV块之间分配缓存空间，以替代传统的LRU逐出策略。

Result: 在合成文档问答任务上，KV缓存命中率提升最高10.8%，首Token生成时间（TTFT）降低最高12.6%；在真实对话任务上，分别提升2.1%和2.0%。在批量推理场景下仍表现良好。

Conclusion: 该自适应缓存方法有效解决多工作负载相互干扰问题，具有清晰的解释性，能很好地适应多样化的推理工作负载。

Abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is a powerful technique for accelerating large language model inference and generation. Inference workloads are large and diverse, which makes them difficult to cache effectively. Existing cache management strategies adopt the least-recently-used policy for evicting cache blocks. However, LRU leads to multiple unrelated workloads flushing each other's caches. To address this, we integrate adaptive caching that dynamically allocates cache space between recently and frequently occurring KV blocks. Evaluations show that it improves the KV cache hit rate by up to 10.8% and reduces time to first token by up to 12.6% over naive vLLM on synthetic document question answering workloads, and 2.1% and 2.0% respectively on real-world conversation workloads. The method generalizes well to batch inference and demonstrates clear interpretability while effectively accommodating diverse workloads.

</details>


### [288] [SwarmX: Agentic Scheduling for Low-Latency Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21401)
*Yeqi Huang,Yanwei Ye,Guomin Chen,Wenhao Su,Bin Gong,Jialian Li,Zhan Lu,Yangshen Deng,Xuan Sun,Le Xu,Luo Mai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SwarmX 是一个针对 Agentic AI 应用的调度系统，通过调度专用神经预测器捕获提示词、设备、运行时和目标模型特征，结合分布式预测和调度器-智能体框架，在近千 GPU 和百万 CPU 核心的生产部署中，相比现有方案将尾延迟降低最高 61.5%，吞吐量提升至 2 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic AI 应用涉及多次模型调用和工具执行，其推理时间和调用结构高度依赖提示词语义，传统 GPU-CPU 集群调度方法无法满足低延迟服务需求。

Method: SwarmX 设计了调度专用神经预测器以捕获提示词、设备、运行时和目标模型特征；将分布预测暴露给路由器和缩放器以实现尾部感知决策；提供预测器训练和在线自适应机制；所有组件集成在调度器-智能体框架中，兼容现有调度和模型服务基础设施。

Result: 在生产部署（近千 GPU 和百万 CPU 核心）和 128-GPU 测试床实验中，针对多智能体代码生成、深度研究和多模态智能体工作流，SwarmX 将尾延迟降低最高 61.5%，在相同 SLO 下吞吐量达到生产调度器的 2 倍。

Conclusion: SwarmX 通过神经预测驱动的智能调度有效解决了 Agentic AI 应用的低延迟服务问题，在真实大规模生产环境中显著优于现有调度方案。

Abstract: Agentic AI applications compose multiple model calls and tool executions, creating new scheduling challenges for GPU-CPU clusters. Their inference time and model-call structure often depend on prompt semantics, making conventional scheduling approaches ineffective for low-latency serving. This paper presents SwarmX, a system that implements agentic scheduling for low-latency agentic applications. SwarmX uses scheduling-specific neural predictors to capture prompt, device, runtime, and target-model features; exposes distributional predictions to routers and scalers for tail-aware decisions; and provides mechanisms for predictor training and online adaptation. These predictors and mechanisms are integrated into a scheduler-agent framework that provides a common substrate for integration with existing scheduling and model-serving infrastructure. We evaluate SwarmX using production deployment (nearly one thousand GPUs and one million CPU cores) and controlled experiments on a 128-GPU testbed. Across multi-agent code generation, deep research, and multimodal agentic workflows, SwarmX reduces tail latency by up to 61.5% compared to state-of-the-art schedulers and sustains up to 2x the throughput of production schedulers under the same SLO.

</details>


### [289] [Bridging Design and Execution: A Visual Graph Editor for Edge and Cloud Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21416)
*Katarina-Glorija Grujić,Nikola Stanković,Maja Vukasović,Miloš Simić*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向边缘与云计算环境的领域特定可视化图形编辑器，支持以核（kernels）、共享内存节点（shared memory nodes）和事件触发器（event triggers）三种一等抽象来建模模块化应用，并将设计图自动序列化为JSON/XML格式以对接执行API，通过联邦学习工作流示例验证了其在分布式环境下的可部署性与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决边缘与云计算环境中模块化应用设计的协调难题，弥合设计时建模与运行时部署之间的鸿沟，提供显式的执行语义以改善对数据共享、执行顺序及依赖关系的推理。

Method: 开发了一个领域特定可视化图形编辑器，提供三种一等抽象（计算核、共享内存节点、事件触发器），支持用户通过统一接口以图形方式建模应用，自动序列化为JSON/XML机器可读格式，并通过执行API实现部署。

Result: 相比于传统工作流编辑器和通用图表工具，该系统提供了显式的执行语义、模块化能力以及直接的可部署性。通过联邦学习工作流案例展示了其有效性，其中本地训练核通过事件驱动协调与共享全局模型交互。

Conclusion: 该工作为分布式环境中模块化计算的可视化编排奠定了基础，支持用户自定义核、事件类型及替代执行后端，为未来探索复杂分布式应用提供了可扩展性。

Abstract: Designing modular applications for edge and cloud computing environments involves coordinating multiple computational kernels, shared data, and event-driven execution. This paper presents a domain-specific visual graph editor that enables users to model such applications using a unified interface. The editor supports three first-class abstractions: kernels, representing computational units; shared memory nodes, modeling distributed data; and event triggers, capturing execution dependencies. Users can construct graphs visually, configure node properties, and connect elements to define data and control flow. The resulting graphs are automatically serialized into machine-readable representations (JSON/XML) and can be passed to an execution API, bridging the gap between design-time modeling and runtime deployment. The editor's graph-based model improves reasoning about data sharing, execution order, and dependencies, particularly in distributed edge and cloud scenarios. To demonstrate its applicability, we discuss a federated learning workflow, where local training kernels interact with a shared global model through event-driven coordination. Compared to traditional workflow editors and general-purpose diagramming tools, the proposed system provides explicit execution semantics, modularity, and direct deployability. This work lays the foundation for visual orchestration of modular computation in distributed environments and offers extensibility for user-defined kernels, event types, and alternative execution backends, enabling future exploration of complex distributed applications.

</details>


### [290] [rush: Scalable Asynchronous Distributed Computing via Shared State in R](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21430)
*Marc Becker,Bernd Bischl*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: rush是一个R语言包，通过Redis数据库提供共享状态协调层，支持异步并行迭代算法，解决了R语言中缺乏去中心化异步并行计算模式的问题，并在超参数优化场景中展示了其实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Python生态中已有多个支持去中心化异步并行的框架（如Optuna、DeepHyper、Hyperopt），但R语言中所有流行的并行计算包都采用集中式控制器-工作器架构，不支持这种模式，因此需要为R语言提供相应的共享状态协调层。

Method: 使用Redis数据库作为共享键值存储，工作器通过数据库读写任务数据并独立执行循环；提供高层API管理任务及其生命周期，具有亚毫秒级开销、鲁棒的错误处理（自动检测丢失工作器）和高效缓存；可选集成mlr3生态系统。

Result: 实现了异步去中心化贝叶斯优化（ADBO），并在四个数据集上使用448个工作器对LightGBM进行超参数优化基准测试，验证了实用性。

Conclusion: rush填补了R语言在去中心化异步并行计算模式上的空白，为统计和机器学习算法的高效并行化提供了新的基础设施。

Abstract: Many algorithms in statistics and machine learning can be parallelized in an asynchronous manner where workers need to communicate through shared state rather than execute independent tasks dispatched by a central controller. Especially in modern hyperparameter optimization and parallel black-box optimization with expensive objectives, this decentralized approach has become widespread, and several Python frameworks adopt it (e.g., Optuna, DeepHyper, and Hyperopt). However, all popular R packages for parallel computing follow a centralized controller-worker architecture that does not support this pattern. We present rush, an R package that provides a shared-state coordination layer for asynchronously parallelized iterative algorithms. rush uses a Redis database as a shared key-value store: workers read and write task data through the database and independently execute their own loops. The package provides a high-level API for managing tasks and their lifecycle, featuring sub-millisecond per-task overhead, robust error handling with automatic detection of lost workers, and efficient caching. rush optionally integrates with the mlr3 ecosystem, powering asynchronous optimization in the bbotk and mlr3tuning packages. We demonstrate the practical utility of rush by implementing asynchronous decentralized Bayesian optimization (ADBO) and benchmarking it on hyperparameter optimization of LightGBM across four datasets using 448 workers.

</details>


### [291] [Towards Global Multi-Cloud Strategies: Insights into AWS and Alibaba Cloud Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21680)
*Martin G. Zizler,Malte Prieß,Christoph P. Neumann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文通过探索性案例研究，对比分析AWS和阿里云在架构、服务和策略上的差异，探讨物联网工作负载在两者间的迁移，总结多云部署的关键技术权衡和最佳实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多云策略日益普及，但AWS与阿里云之间的工作负载集成因互操作性和迁移问题面临挑战，缺乏系统性的比较分析指导。

Method: 采用探索性案例研究方法，利用提供商原生及开源基础设施即代码(IaC)工具，对物联网工作负载在AWS和阿里云之间的迁移进行实证分析。

Result: 识别出AWS与阿里云在架构、服务及策略方面的关键差异及其对工作负载迁移的影响，总结出安全多云部署的技术权衡。

Conclusion: 为企业实现AWS与阿里云互操作性和多云部署提供了技术路线图和最佳实践指导。

Abstract: Multi-cloud strategies are increasingly adopted by modern enterprises to improve agility and resilience and to reduce vendor lock-in. Integrating workloads across providers, such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Alibaba Cloud, remains challenging due to interoperability and migration issues. This paper presents a comparative analysis of AWS and Alibaba Cloud, focusing on architectural, service, and policy differences affecting workload migration. Using both provider-native and open source Infrastructure-as-Code tools, we conduct an exploratory case study about the migration of Internet of Things (IoT) workloads. The results highlight key technical trade-offs and best practices for secure multi-cloud deployments, offering guidance for organizations pursuing AWS and Alibaba Cloud interoperability.

</details>


### [292] [Efficient Domain Decomposition for the Helmholtz Equation on GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21695)
*Amit Rotem*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于GPU的块级域分解方法，使用WaveHoltz作为子域求解器，通过消除设备级同步、用共享内存和寄存器操作替代全局内存访问，在A100上相比MINRES实现了2-25倍加速，且单精度计算可额外获得2-10倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Helmholtz方程在声学、电磁学和地震学中至关重要，但其不定性导致迭代法求解困难。域分解方法虽适合大规模并行架构，但如何在现代GPU上高效实现Helmholtz求解器仍是一大挑战。

Method: (1) 块级域分解方案：每个子域分配给一个线程块，所有求解在单个内核启动中并发运行；(2) 使用WaveHoltz作为子域求解器，它是一种定点迭代方法，内存占用小且无归约操作；(3) 两种线程策略：小子域每线程一个自由度，大子域每线程多个自由度；(4) 支持单精度计算。

Result: 在NVIDIA A100上，WaveHoltz相比MINRES实现2-25倍加速，且优势随子域增大而扩大。单精度相比双精度额外获得2-10倍加速，而MINRES因精度降低导致Krylov向量正交性损失，难以获得类似收益。

Conclusion: 所提出的GPU优化策略有效消除了设备级同步，将全局内存流量替换为共享内存和寄存器级操作，使子域数据大部分驻留在L1和L2缓存中，显著提升了Helmholtz方程在GPU上的求解效率。

Abstract: The Helmholtz equation governs wave propagation in acoustics, electromagnetics, and seismology, but its indefinite nature makes it difficult to solve with iterative methods. Domain decomposition methods are a natural fit for massively parallel architectures, yet mapping efficient Helmholtz solvers onto modern GPUs remains a challenge. We address both with two key contributions: (1) a block-level domain decomposition scheme, in which each subdomain is assigned to a single thread block and all solves run concurrently in a single kernel launch, and (2) WaveHoltz as the subdomain solver. WaveHoltz is a fixed-point iteration that is uniquely well-suited to the GPU execution model due to its minimal memory footprint and no reduction operations. Together, these eliminate device-level synchronizations and replace global memory traffic with shared memory and register-level operations, keeping subdomain data largely resident in L1 and L2 cache. We explore two threading strategies: one degree of freedom per thread for small subdomains, and multiple degrees of freedom per thread for larger ones. Benchmarks of our CUDA based implementation on a NVIDIA A100 show that WaveHoltz achieves 2x-25x speedup over MINRES, with the advantage growing with subdomain size. Crucially, evaluating the subdomain solver in single rather than double precision yields an additional 2x-10x speedup--a benefit largely unattainable by MINRES due to loss of Krylov vector orthogonality under reduced precision.

</details>


### [293] [BatchGen: An Architecture for Scalable and Efficient Batch Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21712)
*Tairan Xu,Leyang Xue,Zhan Lu,Jinfu Deng,Hongyang Xiao,Yinsicheng Jiang,Congjie He,Matej Sandor,Le Xu,Luo Mai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出序列协程计算模型（Sequence Coroutine Compute Model）作为批推理的新型架构基础，将每个序列表示为细粒度、事件驱动的协程，使运行时能够动态重组工作负载。基于该抽象实现了生产级系统BatchGen，在128-GPU集群上减少批完成时间达2.3倍，在内存受限加速器上比最强卸载基线快9.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理引擎沿用交互式服务的执行模型，无法满足批推理在百万序列规模下的两个核心需求：运行时才显现的极端序列间/序列内负载变化，以及跨大规模GPU集群维持高利用率的能力。现有系统因此损失大量可实现的吞吐量。

Method: 提出序列协程计算模型，将每个序列建模为细粒度、事件驱动的协程，暴露表达性原语使运行时能动态重组工作，包括：扩大专家级批次、缓解掉队者、跨设备重分配工作、在低成本或内存受限GPU上维持利用率。基于此抽象实现生产级系统BatchGen。

Result: 在128-GPU集群上，BatchGen将批完成时间降低最多2.3倍；在内存受限加速器上，性能比最强卸载基线提升最多9.6倍。

Conclusion: 序列协程计算模型为批推理提供了新的架构基础，能够有效应对大规模批处理中的负载变化和利用率挑战，BatchGen证明了该方法的实际可行性。项目将开源。

Abstract: Batch inference has become a central mode of AI computation, yet existing inference engines still rely on execution models designed for interactive serving. When scaled to millions of sequences, batch workloads reveal two fundamental requirements: the ability to handle extreme inter- and intra-sequence load variation that emerges only at runtime, and the ability to sustain high utilization across large fleets of GPUs. Existing systems fail to meet these requirements, losing substantial fractions of achievable throughput.
  We introduce a new architectural foundation for batch inference: the sequence coroutine compute model, which represents each sequence as a fine-grained, event-driven coroutine. This model exposes expressive primitives that allow the runtime to reorganize work dynamically, enabling larger expert-level batches, mitigating stragglers, reallocating work across devices, and maintaining utilization even on cost-effective or memory-constrained GPUs. Building on this abstraction, we implement BatchGen, a production-ready system that uses the coroutine model at cluster scale. On a 128-GPU cluster, BatchGen reduces batch completion time by up to $2.3\times$, and on memory-constrained accelerators it outperforms the strongest offloading baseline by up to $9.6\times$. We will open-source BatchGen at https://github.com/batchgen-project/batchgen

</details>


### [294] [KineticSim: A Lightweight, High-Performance Execution Engine for Real-Time Market Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21784)
*Shakya Jayakody,Prarthinie Jayakody*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种持久化状态缓存与共享内存协同归约的并行设计模式，并基于此实现 KineticSim GPU 引擎，在限价订单簿模拟中达到每秒 547 亿 agent 事件吞吐量，相比 CPU (NumPy) 加速 3406 倍，相比 PyTorch GPU 加速 27.8 倍，且内存占用降低约一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 CPU 模拟器受顺序处理瓶颈限制，而向量化 GPU 框架存在内核启动开销和全局内存冗余往返问题，亟需一种可复用的并行设计模式来加速大规模多智能体金融市场模拟。

Method: 提出持久化状态承载清结算（persistent, state-carrying clearing）并行设计模式：将可变模拟状态缓存在线程块共享内存中跨步骤持久化，通过共享内存原子操作聚合智能体行为，协作完成清结算函数。基于此实现 KineticSim GPU 引擎，并行模拟大量限价订单簿。

Result: 每步关键路径深度从 Theta(L+A) 降至 Theta(log L + ceil(A/L))；峰值吞吐量超 547 亿 agent 事件/秒；加速比：CPU (NumPy) 3406x、PyTorch GPU 27.8x、JAX GPU 42.8x、naive CUDA 8.4x；GPU 内存仅为 PyTorch 约 1/10；53 种配置下两个 CUDA 引擎生成 bitwise 一致的订单簿，聚合统计与 CPU 参考偏差 <0.1%。

Conclusion: 该模式可推广至其他需要状态持久化、块局部化归约的迭代多智能体工作负载，为大规模金融市场模拟提供了高效、可复用的 GPU 并行方案。

Abstract: Simulating financial markets at scale with multi-agent (Agent-Based) models is critical for market design, regulatory stress-testing, and reinforcement learning, but traditional CPU simulators are bottlenecked by sequential processing while vectorized GPU frameworks suffer from kernel-launch overhead and redundant global-memory round-trips. We formalize, analyze, and evaluate a reusable parallel design pattern: persistent, state-carrying clearing for iterative multi-agent reductions. By caching mutable simulation state in thread-block shared memory across step boundaries, aggregating agent actions via shared-memory atomics, and resolving the clearing function cooperatively, the pattern reduces the per-step critical-path depth from Theta(L+A) for sequential clearing (L price-grid ticks, A agents) to Theta(log L + ceil(A/L)) and makes global-memory traffic independent of the step count. We implement this in KineticSim, a lightweight GPU execution engine that simulates massive ensembles of limit-order books in parallel, reaching a peak throughput of over 54.7 billion agent-events per second. On a fixed workload it delivers speedups of 3406x over CPU (NumPy), 27.8x over PyTorch GPU, 42.8x over JAX GPU, and 8.4x over a naive custom CUDA baseline, while using roughly an order of magnitude less GPU memory than PyTorch. Across 53 configurations the two custom CUDA engines produce bitwise-identical order books, and aggregate statistics match the CPU reference to within 0.1%. The pattern generalizes to other iterative multi-agent workloads requiring state-persistent, block-localized reductions.

</details>


### [295] [Rethinking Burst Buffer Optimization: Enabling Layout Heterogeneity via Hybrid Analysis and LLM Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21852)
*Yuhan Cai,Huijun Wu,Zhuo Tang,Kehua Guo,Wenzhe Zhang,Zhenwei Wu,Zhouyang Jia,Ruibo Wang,Yong Dong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Proteus是一种语义感知的突发缓冲区系统，通过结合静态代码结构与轻量级运行时信号重构应用I/O意图，在无需预先训练或详尽分析的情况下自动选择最优数据布局，相比现有方案可实现最高3.24倍（写密集）和2.9倍（元数据密集）的加速，决策准确率达91.30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有突发缓冲区文件系统因固定数据布局与多样化应用行为不匹配导致性能下降；基于机器学习的优化仅调优存储栈参数而无法解决根本的布局不匹配问题，且训练或分析成本过高。

Method: 提出Proteus系统，核心思想是通过协同融合静态代码结构与轻量级运行时信号来重构应用I/O意图；采用混合管道和单次执行探针，在生产运行前提取潜在语义线索以确定最优数据布局，无需预先训练或详尽分析。

Result: 在代表性HPC负载下，Proteus决策准确率达91.30%，写密集型工作负载加速最高3.24倍，元数据密集型工作负载加速最高2.9倍。

Conclusion: Proteus通过将数据布局作为一阶优化维度，以语义感知方式有效解决了突发缓冲区中I/O模式与数据组织不匹配的问题，实现了显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Burst buffers (BBs) are essential for mitigating I/O bottlenecks in modern HPC systems. However, existing BB file systems often suffer from structural performance degradation due to fixed data layouts that fail to align with diverse application behaviors. While current machine-learning-based optimizations focus primarily on tuning storage stack parameters for a given layout, they offer diminishing returns when a fundamental mismatch exists between I/O patterns and the underlying data organization. Furthermore, these approaches typically incur prohibitive costs due to extensive training or intrusive profiling. To bridge this gap, we present Proteus, a semantic-aware BB system that treats data layout as a first-class optimization dimension. The core insight of Proteus is that application I/O intent can be reconstructed by synergetically combining static code structures with lightweight runtime signals. Through a hybrid pipeline and a single execution probe, Proteus extracts latent semantic cues to determine the optimal layout prior to production runs-eliminating the need for prior training or exhaustive profiling. Evaluation with representative HPC workloads shows that Proteus achieves 91.30\% decision accuracy, delivering up to 3.24$\times$ and 2.9$\times$ speedups for write-intensive and metadata-intensive workloads, respectively.

</details>


### [296] [StickyInvoc: Rethinking Task Models for High-throughput Workflows in the LLM Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22175)
*Thanh Son Phung,Douglas Thain*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出StickyInvoc，通过"粘性任务+调用任务"解耦计算状态的创建与销毁，将LLM推理工作流加速3.6倍，并在空闲GPU上弹性扩展至186块GPU完成150k次推理任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统HPC任务模型要求每个LLM推理任务重复创建和销毁多GB模型参数状态，在高吞吐、异构、可抢占的HPC集群上造成巨大的性能开销，亟需一种新的任务模型来消除这一瓶颈。

Method: 提出StickyInvoc双任务模型："粘性任务"在计算节点上基于用户模板创建持久化计算状态但不执行有效计算；"调用任务"继承该状态执行实际推理，退出时不销毁状态。将状态创建开销分摊到多次推理调用中。

Result: 在20块GPU的稳定测试平台上，包含150k次推理的声明验证工作流获得3.6倍加速；通过增量扩展至186块空闲GPU，整个工作流仅需784秒完成。

Conclusion: StickyInvoc通过解耦状态创建与执行，有效消除了LLM推理工作流中的状态重建开销，为高吞吐HPC工作负载提供了高效、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: The integration of LLMs into high-throughput workflows is creating a new class of workloads on HPC clusters that promises to accelerate advances in scientific discovery with unprecedented generative capabilities. However, the traditional task model imposes a prohibitive overhead in this new domain: each task must create its computational state from scratch and destroy it upon completion. For each LLM inference task, this "create-destroy" model forces the repeated and costly transfer of multi-gigabyte model parameters from a long-term, reliable storage to a compute node's local disk, its CPU memory, and finally its GPU memory. This overhead, compounded by the inherently high startup cost of LLM inference, the typical scale of thousands of tasks in high-throughput workflows, and the heterogeneous and preemptible nature of high-throughput resources, presents a significant performance barrier.
  To overcome this barrier, this paper presents StickyInvoc: a symbiotic relationship between two new task models for high-throughput workflows. Specifically, a "sticky" task creates a persistent state on a compute node from a user-provided template, but doesn't execute any goodput computation by itself. Instead, this state is then inherited by subsequent "invocation" tasks, which perform the actual computation without incurring the state creation overhead or destroying the state upon exit. StickyInvoc thus allows the decoupling of the creation and destruction of computational states, allowing the computational state of LLM models to be created once per sticky task and its cost amortized over many subsequent invocation tasks. Our evaluation shows that when rewritten in the StickyInvoc paradigm, a claim verification workflow consisting of 150k inferences achieves a 3.6x speedup on a stable testbed with 20 GPUs, and completes in just 784 seconds by incrementally scaling out to 186 otherwise idle GPUs.

</details>


### [297] [FeLoG: Scalable and Efficient Distributed Graph Embedding with Feedback Loop Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22180)
*Peng Fang,Arijit Khan,Ziqiang Wu,Zhenli Li,Yibo Zhou,Fang Wang,Dan Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FeLoG是一个基于反馈循环的分布式图嵌入系统，通过反馈耦合采样训练、活动感知通信和轮次交错流水线，在大规模图数据上实现平均27.9倍加速、通信成本降低53.1%以上，并保持超过80%的CPU-GPU利用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图嵌入框架采用解耦的采样-训练范式，采样过程无法感知嵌入质量，导致对已充分训练区域进行冗余探索，而对欠训练节点采样不足；在分布式环境下，这种解耦进一步导致通信开销过大、执行串行化以及资源利用率低下。

Method: (1) 反馈耦合采样训练：根据实时嵌入质量反馈动态优先采样欠训练节点，减少冗余计算并加速收敛；(2) 活动感知通信：压缩频繁出现的节点序列以减少PCIe流量，选择性同步频繁更新的嵌入以减少机器间通信；(3) 轮次交错流水线：将下一轮采样与当前轮训练重叠，提高CPU-GPU利用率。

Result: 在六种最先进基线的大规模图数据上，FeLoG实现平均27.9倍加速，通信成本降低53.1%以上，CPU-GPU利用率维持在80%以上。

Conclusion: FeLoG通过反馈驱动的采样训练、活动感知通信和流水线执行，有效解决了大规模分布式图嵌入的可扩展性和效率问题。

Abstract: Graph embedding maps graph nodes into low-dimensional vectors to support applications such as recommendation, fraud detection, and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG). As graphs scale to billions of edges, scalable and efficient graph embedding has become increasingly important. Existing frameworks commonly adopt a sampling-training paradigm, in which mini-batches are constructed by sampling nodes and their neighbors. However, sampling is typically decoupled from evolving embedding quality, causing redundant exploration of well-trained regions while under-sampling undertrained nodes. At the system level, such decoupling further leads to excessive communication, serialized execution, and low resource utilization in distributed environments. We present FeLoG, a feedback loop-driven system for scalable distributed graph embedding. (1) FeLoG introduces feedback-coupled sampling and training, dynamically prioritizing undertrained nodes according to real-time embedding-quality feedback, thereby reducing redundant computation and accelerating convergence. (2) It employs activity-aware communication that compresses frequently occurring node sequences to reduce intra-machine PCIe traffic and selectively synchronizes frequently updated embeddings to reduce inter-machine communication. (3) It adopts a round-interleaved pipeline that overlaps next-round sampling with current-round training to improve CPU-GPU utilization. Experiments against six state-of-the-art baselines on large-scale graphs show that FeLoG achieves an average speedup of 27.9x, reduces communication cost by more than 53.1%, and sustains over 80% CPU-GPU utilization.

</details>


### [298] [Hardwired Pattern Formation by Mobile Robots with Common Unit Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22386)
*Yuta Kojima,Sébastien Tixeuil,Yukiko Yamauchi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出硬连线模式形成（HwPTF）问题，要求移动机器人以指定大小形成目标图案。研究发现：两个 oblivious 半同步机器人无法解决含多重性的 HwPTF（即会合问题），但可解决无多重性的 HwPTF；两个配备灯光的 oblivious 异步机器人可以解决该问题，而普通 oblivious 异步机器人则不能；最后提出了一个针对四个以上 oblivious 半同步机器人的尺寸调整算法，结合现有模式形成算法可得到 HwPTF 算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模式形成（PTF）问题允许对目标图案进行平移、旋转和缩放，但实际应用中可能需要以精确尺寸形成指定图案。本文旨在探索更严格的约束条件下（固定尺寸、无缩放自由度）机器人分布式协调的能力边界。

Method: 通过理论分析研究 obliviousness（无记忆性）和 synchronization（同步性）对 HwPTF 问题可解性的影响；针对不同机器人模型（半同步、异步、带灯光）进行分类讨论；提出尺寸调整算法作为构建 HwPTF 算法的通用模块。

Result: 1) 两个 oblivious 半同步机器人可解无多重性的 HwPTF，但不可解含多重性的 HwPTF（即会合问题）。2) 两个带灯光的 oblivious 异步机器人可解 HwPTF，但普通 oblivious 异步机器人不可解。3) 针对四个以上 oblivious 半同步机器人提出尺寸调整算法，可与现有 PTF 算法结合得到 HwPTF 算法。

Conclusion: HwPTF 问题比传统 PTF 问题约束更强，揭示了不同机器人模型下精确图案形成的能力边界。通过理论分析明确了 obliviousness、同步性、灯光等计算资源对问题可解性的影响，并提供了构造性算法方案。

Abstract: The pattern formation (PTF) problem requires mobile robots to form a specified target pattern. Existing papers investigated the PTF problem and revealed the effect of obliviousness and synchronization on distributed coordination of mobile robots. However, the PTF problem allows translation, rotation, and scaling of the target pattern. In this paper, we introduce a novel pattern formation problem, called the hardwired pattern formation (HwPTF) problem that requires the robots to form a given target pattern in a specified size. Although two oblivious semi-synchronous robots cannot solve the HwPTF problem of multiplicity two (i.e., the rendezvous problem), we show that they can solve the HwPTF problem without multiplicity. We also show that two oblivious asynchronous robots equipped with lights can solve the HwPTF problem, while oblivious asynchronous robots cannot. We finally present a size-adjusting algorithm for more than four oblivious semi-synchronous robots, that yields a HwPTF algorithm when combined with some existing pattern formation algorithms.

</details>


### [299] [ASAP: A Disaggregated and Asynchronous Inference System for MoE Prefill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22541)
*Weiwei Chen,Shuang Chen,Lele Li,Qiang Hu,Han Li,Xin Ye,Ming Yan,Zhibin Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: ASAP是一个专为加速MoE模型预填充阶段设计的异步推理系统，通过解耦注意力与MoE阶段、实现完全异步执行流水线，消除了全局同步屏障，在CloudMatrix384超级节点上将符合SLO的预填充吞吐量提升了90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代MoE服务系统采用DP与EP混合并行策略，但在线服务中请求到达率和序列长度的显著变化导致DP不平衡，引发严重的同步停滞，降低了首Token延迟和系统吞吐量。

Method: ASAP解耦注意力与MoE阶段，实现完全异步执行流水线；设计了一套专门的异步通信原语；在请求调度和模型执行层面进行了四项协同优化，共同消除全局同步屏障。

Result: 在CloudMatrix384超级节点上，ASAP相比最先进的同步服务方案，将符合SLO的预填充吞吐量提升了90%。

Conclusion: 异步执行架构能有效消除MoE模型服务中的全局同步屏障，显著提升预填充阶段的吞吐量和性能。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the de facto standard for scaling large language models. To maintain computational efficiency, modern MoE serving systems typically employ a hybrid parallelism strategy, combining Data Parallelism (DP) for attention stages with Expert Parallelism (EP) for MoE stages. However, this design necessitates frequent global synchronization barriers between attention DP groups and experts. In online serving, significant variance in request arrival rates and sequence lengths inherently leads to DP imbalance, causing severe synchronization stalls that degrade Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) and system throughput. We present ASAP, an asynchronous inference system specifically designed to accelerate the prefill phase of MoE models. ASAP disaggregates the attention and MoE stages and implements a fully asynchronous execution pipeline. This is achieved through a suite of specialized asynchronous communication primitives and four coordinated optimizations across request scheduling and model execution, which collectively dismantle global synchronization barriers. We implement and evaluate ASAP on CloudMatrix384 super-nodes, demonstrating that it improves SLO-compliant prefill throughput by 90% compared to state-of-the-art synchronous serving solutions.

</details>


### [300] [EchoFlow: A Workload-Aware Parameter Tuning Method for Blockchain Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22934)
*Ben Lian,Linpeng Jia,Xing Chen,Xiaofeng Chen,Yi Sun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: EchoFlow是一个基于分布式强化学习和遗传算法的区块链参数自适应调优框架，能根据工作负载特征持续优化参数配置，在不同场景下均优于现有方法并缩短训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区块链系统存在大量可调参数且显著影响性能，但实践中常采用单一参数配置应对不同工作负载，导致大量性能潜力未被挖掘。

Method: 采用分布式强化学习方法，多个actor并行采样以缓解区块链环境中样本生成耗时过长的问题；并在训练初期引入遗传算法生成高质量样本来加速收敛。

Result: 实验表明EchoFlow在多种工作负载场景下均优于现有方法，同时有效减少了训练时间。

Conclusion: EchoFlow能够根据工作负载特征自适应调整参数配置，实现持续性能优化，验证了其有效性和实用价值。

Abstract: Blockchain systems expose a large number of tunable parameters that significantly influence system performance. However, in practice, a single parameter configuration is often applied across different workloads, leaving substantial unexploited performance potential. To address this, we propose EchoFlow, a blockchain parameter tuning framework that adaptively adjusts parameter configurations based on workload characteristics, enabling continuous performance optimization. EchoFlow employs a distributed reinforcement learning approach in which multiple actors perform parallel sampling to mitigate the substantial time required for sample generation in blockchain environments. To further accelerate convergence, we introduce a genetic algorithm during the initial phase of training to generate high-quality samples. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that EchoFlow consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse workload scenarios while also reducing training time, highlighting its effectiveness and practical value.

</details>


### [301] [Decentralized Operations of Decarbonized Chemical Plants with Renewable-driven Transmission Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22973)
*Richard Reed,kazi Arman Ahmed,Saba Ghasemi,Zheyu Jiang,Paritosh Ramanan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于数据隔离的隐私友好型去中心化框架，用于联合优化电力系统的机组组合问题和电化学乙烷裂解厂微电网调度，采用带有辅助系统级惩罚的ADMM算法加速收敛，并在ACTIVSg2000测试案例上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乙烷裂解电气化是实现工业脱碳的有效途径，但电气化化工厂微电网与脱碳电网的整合需要独立系统运营商与化工厂之间的联合运营规划，而工厂运营数据的高度机密性阻碍了这一整合过程。

Method: 提出了一种基于数据隔离的隐私友好型去中心化框架，采用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）并辅以辅助系统级惩罚以加速收敛，各子系统仅共享最小化协调信号，分别求解本地子问题。

Result: 在ACTIVSg2000（德克萨斯输电网合成模型）上进行了数值实验，映射了26个化工厂至最近电网连接点。数据隔离导致的最优性差距始终较小，排放后果与负荷相关且非单调。

Conclusion: 该框架在保护数据隐私的前提下实现了电力-化工联合系统的协同优化，量化了隐私友好型分解的成本，验证了其在真实场景中的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Electrification of ethane cracking offers a promising pathway to industrial decarbonization, provided that the electricity is sourced from renewable energy. However, integrating electrified chemical plant microgrids with a decarbonized power grid requires joint operations planning between Independent System Operators and chemical plants, which is hindered by the highly confidential nature of plant operational data. In this paper, we propose a privacy-friendly decentralized framework based on data isolation that jointly optimizes the Unit Commitment problem in the power system and microgrid scheduling in electrified ethane cracker plants. The framework employs the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers, augmented with an auxiliary system-level penalty that accelerates convergence, allowing each subsystem to solve its local subproblem and share only minimal coordination signals. To reflect real-world conditions, numerical experiments are conducted on the ACTIVSg2000 test case, a synthetic model of the Texas transmission network, with 26 chemical plants identified from Texas mapped to their nearest grid connection points. In doing so, we characterize the cost of privacy-friendly decomposition on joint power and chemical system decisions, showing that data isolation results in consistently small optimality gaps, and that its emissions consequences are load-dependent and non-monotone.

</details>


### [302] [LiveServe: Interaction-Aware Serving for Real-Time Omni-Modal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22983)
*Xiangyu Zhi,Peiqi Yin,Sheng Guan,Chenguang Zheng,James Cheng,Xiao Yan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: LiveServe是一个面向实时全模态LM交互的交互感知服务系统，通过将播放进度、语音活动和打断事件暴露给服务流水线，改进了调度和KV缓存管理策略，显著降低音频首包延迟并提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态LM服务系统仍使用面向吞吐量的LLM调度和LRU KV缓存卸载策略，忽略了音频播放状态和多轮复用需求：可能生成远超用户实际听到的token，在用户打断（barge-in）后浪费计算；且错误驱逐下一轮对话所需的KV状态。

Method: LiveServe将播放进度、语音活动和打断事件暴露给服务流水线。调度器优先服务首音频和接近欠载（near-underrun）的会话，并限制生成超过播放前沿的token。KV管理器采用下次使用感知（next-use-aware）的驱逐策略，并在用户语音期间预加载可能需要的KV状态以隐藏重载延迟。

Result: 基于vLLM-Omni，在两种Omni-LM和混合工作负载上，LiveServe将P90音频TTFP平均降低1.55倍（最高2.21倍），已完成请求吞吐量平均提升1.15倍（最高1.56倍），并将大部分KV重载工作移出下一轮的临界路径。

Conclusion: 交互感知的调度和KV管理策略能有效优化实时全模态LM服务，避免浪费计算并隐藏KV重载延迟，显著提升用户体验和系统效率。

Abstract: Realtime omni-modal LMs support speech-centric conversations where users stream inputs, hear generated audio, and interrupt freely. Existing Omni-LM serving systems still rely on throughput-oriented LLM scheduling and LRU KV offloading. These policies ignore audio playback and multi-turn reuse: they may generate tokens far beyond what users hear, wasting work after barge-in, and evict KV state needed in the next turn. LiveServe is an interaction-aware serving system for realtime Omni-LM interaction. It exposes playback progress, speech activity, and barge-in events to the serving pipeline. The scheduler prioritizes first-audio and near-underrun sessions while limiting generation beyond the playback frontier. The KV manager uses next-use-aware eviction and preloads likely-needed KV during user speech to hide reload latency. On vLLM-Omni, LiveServe improves realtime serving across two Omni-LMs and mixed workloads. It lowers P90 audio TTFP by $1.55\times$ on average and up to $2.21\times$, while improving completed-request throughput by $1.15\times$ on average and up to $1.56\times$, and moves most KV reload work off the next-turn critical path.

</details>


### [303] [Nautilus: A Verifiable Hierarchical Federated Learning Framework for Vehicular-Edge-Cloud Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23017)
*Linyang Wu,Linpeng Jia,Hanwen Zhang,Tiantian Duan,Yi Sun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Nautilus是一个针对车联网联邦学习的可验证高效框架，通过多维资源感知调度算法和零知识证明机制，在提升训练效率的同时确保调度公平性和客户端执行合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车联网场景中车辆-边缘-云资源的极端异构性严重限制了联邦学习的系统效率，而动态调度策略虽然能缓解该问题，却引入了新的信任危机：如何验证调度决策的公平性，以及客户端是否在不出隐私数据的前提下忠实执行优化指令。

Method: 1) 设计多维资源感知调度算法，根据车辆带宽、延迟和计算能力动态分配压缩比和训练任务；2) 引入零知识证明机制，在保护隐私的同时确保调度策略生成的公平性和客户端执行的合规性。

Result: 该框架有效降低了通信开销，加速了模型收敛，同时维护了系统完整性。

Conclusion: Nautilus通过结合资源感知调度与零知识证明，成功解决了异构联邦学习中的效率与信任双重挑战，为车联网场景提供了可行的隐私保护协作学习方案。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative learning for Internet of Vehicles (IoV) scenarios, but the extreme heterogeneity of vehicular-edge-cloud resources severely limits system efficiency. While dynamic scheduling strategies can mitigate this issue, they introduce new trust concerns: how to verify that scheduling decisions are fair, and whether clients faithfully execute optimization instructions without disclosing private data? This paper proposes Nautilus, a verifiable and efficient federated learning framework. First, we design a multi-dimensional resource-aware scheduling algorithm that dynamically allocates compression ratios and training tasks based on vehicles bandwidth, latency, and computing power, significantly improving system training efficiency. Second, to address the trust deficit in the scheduling process, we introduce a Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) mechanism that ensures the fairness of scheduling strategy generation and the compliance of client execution while preserving privacy. Experimental results demonstrate that the framework effectively reduces communication overhead and accelerates model convergence while maintaining system integrity.

</details>


### [304] [Solving Approximate Agreement on continuous and discrete spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23260)
*Augustin Albert,Sergio Rajsbaum*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了异步崩溃进程通过共享读写寄存器实现的免等待近似一致问题，分析了连续空间（CUB空间）和离散空间（单纯复形）下的可解性条件：连续情况下ε-一致在任意CUB空间可解，离散情况下n+1个进程的单纯形一致可解当且仅当单纯复形是(n-1)-连通的，并证明了Ledent猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近似一致问题在异步崩溃系统中已有广泛研究，但不同输入空间（连续/离散、一维/多维）下的可解性条件尚不统一。本文旨在建立更一般的理论框架，统一刻画不同输入空间下近似一致问题的可解性边界。

Method: 本文采用拓扑方法，在连续方面引入CUB空间（一类具有唯一凸性定义的度量空间），在离散方面利用单纯复形的连通性条件，分别推导了ε-一致和单纯形一致问题的可解性充要条件。

Result: (1) ε-一致在任意CUB空间均可解；(2) 对于单纯复形C，n+1个进程的单纯形一致可解当且仅当C是(n-1)-连通的；(3) 证明了Ledent猜想。

Conclusion: 本文统一了连续与离散情况下近似一致问题的可解性理论，揭示了问题可解性完全由输入空间的拓扑连通性决定，为异步分布式计算提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: We consider $n$ asynchronous processes prone to crashes, communicating via shared read-write registers, and study the wait-free solvability of approximate agreement: given inputs, processes must output values that are close to each other, and satisfy a validity property. At the very least, if inputs are identical, all outputs must equal that input.
  The problem has been studied for various input spaces: continuous, discrete, one-dimensional or multidimensional. For metric spaces, validity requires outputs to lie in the convex hull of the inputs. For graphs, and more generally simplicial complexes, several conditions exist. We focus on simplex validity: if inputs span a simplex $σ$, then outputs are in $σ$. Agreement requires that outputs span a simplex.
  Solvability depends on the input space, validity condition, and number of processes. For example, the problem is solvable for all $n$ in the plane, but only for $n \leq 2$ when removing a point. For a graph, solvability for $n=2$ holds iff the graph is connected, but $n\geq 3$ requires acyclicity.
  In the continuous setting, we consider CUB spaces: a broad class of metric spaces admitting a unique convexity definition, subsuming classical $ε$-agreement on $[0,1]$ and $m$-dimensional approximate agreement. Our results show that $ε$-agreement is solvable in every CUB space. In the discrete case, we prove that simplex agreement on a simplicial complex $\mathcal{C}$ is solvable for $n+1$ processes iff $\mathcal{C}$ is $(n-1)$-connected. We discuss several consequences, including a proof of a conjecture by Ledent.

</details>


### [305] [Node-Level Performance and Energy Characterization of Flagship Science Applications on SuperMUC-NG Phase 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23265)
*Salvatore Cielo,Elmira Birang,Alexander Pöppl,Sajad Azizi,Plamen Dobrev,Margarita Egelhofer,Ivan Pribec,Gerald Mathias*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了SuperMUC-NG phase 2上五个旗舰科学工作负载（GROMACS、LAMMPS、OpenGadget3、AthenaK、deal.II）在CPU-only（Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+）与CPU+GPU（Intel Max 1550）配置下的吞吐量和能效。结果显示GPU卸载可带来4-12倍吞吐量提升和最高15倍能效提升，但受问题粒度影响显著，且CPU的功率预算利用率普遍低于GPU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为了对新一代Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ CPU与Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550（Ponte Vecchio）加速器在真实科学工作负载上的性能和能效进行系统性量化比较，填补该硬件组合在实际HPC应用中的评估空白。

Method: 在SuperMUC-NG phase 2系统上，选取五个代表性科学计算代码（GROMACS、LAMMPS、OpenGadget3、AthenaK、deal.II），分别在CPU-only（SPR）和CPU+GPU（SPR+PVC）配置下测量单节点吞吐量（每墙钟秒计算单元数）和能效（每焦耳计算单元数）。能效测量采用轻量级代码插桩工具p3em或系统级Energy Aware Runtime (EAR)。

Result: GPU卸载相比CPU-only执行可获得4-12倍吞吐量提升和最高15倍能效提升，其中LAMMPS和AthenaK获益最大。但收益受问题粒度影响显著，AthenaK在小网格块大小时GPU优势大幅削弱。CPU的功率预算利用率系统性地低于GPU，即使在工作速率峰值时，大多数CPU应用仍无法充分利用节点的热设计功耗。

Conclusion: Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550在科学计算中展现显著的性能和能效优势，但需要足够大的问题粒度才能充分发挥；当前CPU应用普遍存在功率预算利用不足的问题，限制了对节点资源的充分利用。

Abstract: We present a systematic performance and energy-efficiency characterization of five flagship scientific workloads on SuperMUC-NG phase 2, the 28 PetaFLOPs system at the Leibniz Supercomputing Center (LRZ) equipped with Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ and Intel Data Center GPU Max 1550 (Ponte Vecchio, PVC) accelerators. The selected codes span molecular dynamics (gromacs, lammps), astrophysics and cosmology (OpenGadget3, AthenaK), and finite-element PDE solvers from the dealii-X Center of Excellence. For each code we measure throughput and energy efficiency expressed as compute-elements per wall-clock second (or per Joule of consumed energy) on a single compute node, comparing CPU-only (SPR) against combined CPU+GPU (SPR+PVC) configurations where available. Energy measurements rely on lightweight code instrumentation with p3em, or the Energy Aware Runtime (EAR) present on the system. Our results show that GPU offload yields $4-12\times$ higher throughput and up to $15\times$ better energy efficiency compared to CPU-only execution, with lammps and AthenaK benefiting most. However, both throughput and energy gains are sensitive to problem granularity: insufficient work per GPU tile erodes the accelerator advantage, as clearly observed in AthenaK at small mesh-block sizes. The power-budget utilization is systematically lower for CPUs than it is for GPUs, indicating that even at peak useful-work rate, most applications running on CPUs leave a significant fraction of the node's thermal envelope unused.

</details>


### [306] [When Staking Rewards Compound: Measuring the Impact of Ethereum's Pectra Upgrade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23337)
*Mohammed Benseddik,Benjamin Kraner,Claudio J. Tessone*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了以太坊信标链Pectra升级中引入的0x02复合验证者机制，发现复合验证仅提供约+5%的共识层APR提升（对小规模质押者），大型提供商收益不足1%。实证分析显示0x02验证者CL APR略高，但采用率缓慢，主要受限于奖励可访问性不足和经济激励较弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以太坊信标链活跃验证者数量因32 ETH质押上限而膨胀至超过92万，Pectra升级（2025年5月）通过引入0x02复合验证者来解决此问题，将最大质押量从32 ETH提升至2,048 ETH并实现自动复投。本文旨在评估复合验证对共识层奖励的影响、更高余额是否提供执行层优势，以及APR提升是否足以激励不同类型质押者迁移。

Method: 采用模拟方法量化复合验证对共识层APR的影响；对所有活跃信标链验证者进行实证分析，比较0x02验证者与普通验证者的CL APR差异；分析单独质押者和质押服务提供商的采用模式及迁移障碍。

Result: 复合验证对小额余额提供约+5%的相对CL APR提升，对大型质押提供商则降至不足1%；0x02验证者实现了略高的中位数CL APR；单独质押者相对采用率更高但面临操作障碍，质押提供商则面临基础设施成本和协议约束。

Conclusion: 在缺乏更优的奖励可访问性和更强经济激励的情况下，尽管0x02迁移具有网络效率优势，其采用过程仍将保持渐进缓慢。

Abstract: Ethereum's beacon chain hosts over 920,000 active validators, a number inflated by the legacy 32 ETH stake cap. The Pectra upgrade (May 2025) addresses this by introducing 0x02 compounding validators, raising the maximum stake per validator from 32 to 2,048 ETH and enabling automatic reward reinvestment. This paper examines how compounding affects consensus-layer rewards, whether higher balances provide execution-layer advantages, and whether the APR uplift justifies migration for different staker types. We analyse adoption patterns across solo stakers and staking providers, investigate the role of consolidation (merging multiple 32 ETH validators into one) in early migration, and identify barriers slowing the transition. Through simulation, we find that compounding provides roughly +5% relative consensus-layer APR uplift for small balances, diminishing to under 1% for large staking providers. Empirical analysis of all active beacon chain validators shows 0x02 validators achieving modestly higher median CL APR. Solo stakers show higher relative adoption but face operational barriers, whilst providers cite infrastructure costs and protocol constraints. The results suggest that without improved reward accessibility and stronger economic incentives, 0x02 migration will remain gradual despite its network efficiency benefits.

</details>


### [307] [Development and Design of FLKit: A Structured Onboarding Toolkit for Federated Learning in Health and Life Sciences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23500)
*Ashkan Pirmani,Ilse Vermeulen,Goran Vinterhalter,Lotte Geys,Axel Faes,Muhammad Quamber Ali,Nishkala Sattanathan,Geert Vandeweyer,Yves Moreau,Liesbet M. Peeters*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FLKit 是一个面向生命科学领域的开源联邦学习入职工具包，通过角色感知的入口、四个生命周期阶段（治理、基础设施、数据整理、分析）、可复用的 FL Story 模板以及工具目录，帮助多学科团队从零开始规划和实施联邦学习项目。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习技术发展迅速，但在医疗健康等隐私敏感领域，实际落地面临早期障碍：团队面对零散的工具框架、治理要求和陌生角色，缺乏一个结构化的、适配不同背景团队的入门点。

Method: 以 ELIXIR 研究数据管理工具包为模型，由多学科核心团队主导建设，联合更广泛的联盟提供里程碑审查和路线图指导，并通过外部从业者访谈确保内容贴合实际。工具包包含四个生命周期阶段、11个角色特定入口、跨学科术语表、FAIR 对齐的 FL Story 模板以及工具/框架/社区目录。

Result: 截至2024年12月演示，已发展为39页8个章节，包含7个 FL Story 记录已完成和进行中的项目，涉及多发性硬化症残疾预测、炎症性肠病、基因组学和脑机接口等领域。开源地址：https://uhasselt-biomedicaldatasciences.github.io/federated-learning-toolkit/

Conclusion: FLKit 通过结构化、角色感知的入职工具包，有效弥合了联邦学习技术在生命科学领域从理论到实践的早期落地鸿沟，支持社区持续贡献与发展。

Abstract: Federated learning lets institutions train shared models without moving their data, which makes it a natural fit for health and life sciences research under strict privacy regulation. The methods are maturing fast, but the practical barrier now comes earlier: a team starting a federated project meets a scattered mix of frameworks, governance obligations, and unfamiliar roles, with no structured place to begin that fits its own background. FLKit closes that gap. It is an open, community-maintained onboarding toolkit that takes a multidisciplinary team through the full federated learning lifecycle and gives every contributor, clinical, legal, governance, or technical, a role-aware entry point instead of assuming fluency across all four. We modeled it on the ELIXIR Research Data Management Kit and built it with a multidisciplinary core team, a wider consortium supplying milestone reviews and roadmap direction, and external practitioners interviewed to keep the content grounded in real practice. FLKit sits on four lifecycle stages, Governance, Infrastructure, Wrangling, and Analysis, and connects them through 11 role-specific entry points, a cross-disciplinary glossary, a reusable FAIR-aligned FL Story template for planning and documenting projects, and a curated directory of tools, frameworks, and communities. Since the December 2024 demo it has grown to 39 pages across eight sections, with seven FL Stories documenting completed and ongoing projects in multiple sclerosis disability prediction, inflammatory bowel disease, genomics, and brain-computer interfaces. It is openly available at https://uhasselt-biomedicaldatasciences.github.io/federated-learning-toolkit/ and welcomes contributions from across the life sciences.

</details>


### [308] [Concordia: JIT-Compiled Persistent-Kernel Checkpointing for Fault-Tolerant LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23521)
*Yuhang Gan,Yiwei Yang,Yuyi Li,Xiangyu Gao,Yichen Wang,Rain Jiang,Xiaoning Ding,Andi Quinn,Chen Qian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Concordia是一个面向长时间运行LLM agents的容错运行时，通过设备驻留持久内核实现GPU状态（如KV缓存、通信状态）的故障恢复，无需重启整个服务栈或应用级检查点逻辑。它通过PTX/SASS级插桩和JIT编译的增量检查点处理器，利用无锁环形缓冲区协调计算、检查点和恢复任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时间运行的LLM agents在GPU上维护大量宝贵状态（KV缓存、请求调度器、通信状态等），一旦GPU或通信器故障会导致数分钟至数小时的工作丢失。现有恢复机制要么重启整个服务栈，要么需要在每个注意力机制和运行时组件中实现应用特定的检查点逻辑，效率低下。

Method: 提出Concordia运行时：(1) 使用设备驻留持久内核作为基础；(2) 在GPU模块加载时进行拦截，支持PTX和SASS级别的指令插桩，在框架代码和库边界之下插入检查点和暂停钩子；(3) JIT编译专用增量检查点处理器（如KV块扫描器、适配器页面扫描器、恢复应用器）并热替换到持久内核的操作符表中；(4) 持久内核使用无锁环形缓冲区协调计算、检查点、追加日志和恢复任务，实现脏页检测、增量暂存、已提交记录追加到CXL内存或主机DRAM中的CPU可见日志。

Result: 实现了GPU驻留执行上下文，检查点钩子在设备同步点运行，可观察框架和库实际执行的二进制内核，恢复过程无需主机CPU处于关键路径。

Conclusion: Concordia提供了一种高效的、对应用透明的LLM推理容错方案，通过设备端持久内核和增量检查点机制，显著减少了故障恢复的开销和复杂度。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agents keep valuable state resident on GPUs: KV caches, request schedulers, communication state, and sometimes online adapters. Losing this state after a GPU or communicator failure can discard minutes to hours of work, yet existing recovery mechanisms either restart the whole serving stack or require application-specific checkpoint logic inside every attention and runtime component. This paper argues that fault tolerance for such workloads needs a GPU-resident execution context: checkpoint hooks must run at device synchronization points, observe binary kernels that frameworks and libraries actually execute, and recover without putting the host CPU on the critical path.
  We present Concordia, a runtime that uses a device-resident persistent kernel as the substrate for fault-tolerant LLM inference. Concordia interposes on GPU module loading and supports PTX- and SASS-level instrumentation, allowing checkpoint and pause hooks to be inserted below framework code and library boundaries. For each registered LLM state region, Concordia JIT-compiles a specialized delta-checkpoint handler -- for example, a KV-block scanner, adapter-page scanner, or recovery applier -- and hot-swaps it into the persistent kernel's operator table. The persistent kernel consumes a lock-free ring buffer of compute, checkpoint, append-log, and recovery tasks, so the same always-on executor triggers dirty-page detection, stages deltas, and appends committed records to a CPU-visible log in CXL memory or host DRAM.

</details>


### [309] [Kamera: Unified Position-Invariant Multimodal KV Cache for Training-Free Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23581)
*Bole Ma,Jan Eitzinger,Harald Koestler,Gerhard Wellein*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文发现多模态智能体在重复审视相同视频帧/UI截图时存在重复编码问题，并指出传统KV缓存复用在跨块条件绑定上的根本缺陷。作者提出一种无训练的低秩条件补丁方案，通过精确的RoPE重旋转和跨块绑定恢复，实现窗口重排、滑动窗口存活和召回三种低成本操作，在MM-NIAH和双页文档问答等基准上以极小KV开销恢复完整准确率，并在SGLang生产内核上达到bf16精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体反复审视相同视觉内容（视频帧、UI截图）时，每次回看都需要重新编码，因为现有前缀缓存仅在固定位置支持复用，导致大量计算浪费。作者旨在揭示这种重复计算的根本原因，并提出避免方案。

Method: 提出一种无需训练的、存储在每个位置无关块旁的低秩条件补丁。复用操作统一为三个算子：精确的RoPE重旋转到任意目标位置、恢复跨块绑定的条件补丁。支持三种廉价窗口操作：重排（一个补丁服务缓存的任意排序）、滑动窗口存活（仅通过旋转迁移存活块）、召回（通过补丁恢复被驱逐块，无需重新编码）。

Result: 秩为m的补丁在跨块绑定基准（MM-NIAH跨两种注意力家族、双页文档问答）上恢复完整任务准确率，KV开销极小；在SGLang生产内核上跨六个骨干网络将重新填充的KV重建到bf16舍入精度。

Conclusion: 跨块条件绑定缺失是导致简单KV复用失败的根本原因（单跳召回完整但多跳准确率减半），而所提补丁方案有效修复此问题。视觉/视频流中条件信号最强，使该方法对多模态智能体影响最大。

Abstract: Multimodal agents repeatedly re-examine the same video frames, UI screenshots, and rendered artifacts as their context window slides and reasoning iterates, yet every look-back re-encodes from scratch, because prefix caches serve reuse only at a fixed leading position. We show this recompute is avoidable, and identify exactly what naive KV reuse loses: the cross-chunk conditioning a chunk absorbs from its neighbours. This loss is asymmetric. The direct readout of a cached chunk is recovered exactly and for free by the standard state-merge. What remains is a diffuse, low-rank residue concentrated in deep layers, invisible to single-hop retrieval but precisely what multi-hop reasoning binds on. Blind reuse therefore leaves single-hop recall intact while halving multi-hop accuracy; this is the failure mode prior position-independent caches, designed for single-context or single-image reuse, do not address. We repair it with a small, training-free low-rank conditioning patch stored alongside each position-free chunk. Reuse reduces to one operator across MLA, GQA, and MHA: exact RoPE re-rotation to any target position, plus the patch that restores cross-chunk binding. This makes three window operations cheap: reorder (one patch serves every ordering of a cached set), sliding-window survival (surviving chunks relocate via rotation only, zero re-encode), and recall (an evicted chunk is rehydrated by its patch, never re-encoded). A rank-m patch recovers full task accuracy on cross-chunk-binding benchmarks, MM-NIAH across two attention families and two-page doc-QA, at a fraction of the KV footprint, and reconstructs re-prefill KV to within bf16 rounding in a production SGLang kernel across six backbones. The conditioning signal is strongest in redundant vision and video streams, making our solution most impactful where multimodal agents spend their recompute budget.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [310] [On the Identifiability of User Adaptation in Co-Adaptive Neural Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20569)
*Philip Waggoner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析了共适应人机系统中的可识别性问题，证明闭环编码器估计无法唯一识别用户适应行为，而是反映联合系统的特性，并讨论了行为适应解释的含义及识别条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共适应人机系统研究中，对用户适应行为的估计存在可识别性问题，即无法区分观察到的行为变化是源于用户自身的适应还是整个联合系统的特性，这可能导致对用户行为意图的错误解读。

Method: 采用理论分析方法，对共适应人机系统中的闭环编码器估计进行数学建模，分析其可识别性条件，并通过形式化推导证明编码器估计反映的是联合系统而非单一用户适应。

Result: 证明在闭环条件下，编码器估计不能唯一分解为用户适应和机器适应，而是两者耦合的结果；系统辨识需要满足特定的可识别性条件才能分离用户与机器的贡献。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了共适应人机系统分析中的根本性挑战，为设计可识别的实验条件和解释行为适应数据提供了理论指导，有助于更准确地理解和建模人机交互中的双向适应过程。

Abstract: We analyze identifiability in co-adaptive human-machine systems. We show that closed-loop encoder estimates do not uniquely identify user adaptation, but instead reflect properties of the joint system. We discuss implications for interpreting behavioral adaptation and propose conditions for identification.

</details>


### [311] [Beyond Fixed Budgets: Characterizing the Inelasticity and Limitations of Tree-of-Thought Reasoning Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20599)
*Atkia Mahila,Avinash Maurya,M. Mustafa Rafique,Bogdan Nicolae*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了两种代表性Tree of Thought搜索方法（DPTS和SSDP）在不同计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的表现，发现DPTS存在冷启动瓶颈（低预算下表现差），SSDP存在前沿枯竭问题（无法利用多余预算提升效果），表明固定探索或固定剪枝策略均不足以应对不同计算资源条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Tree of Thought搜索方法在实践中表现各异，但不同搜索策略在不同计算预算、模型规模和问题难度下的行为缺乏系统性研究。

Method: 在Math500和GSM8K两个数学推理基准上，使用Llama-3B和Llama-8B两个模型规模，设置3k-10k四种token预算，评估DPTS（基于蒙特卡洛树搜索）和SSDP（基于语义去重）两种代表性ToT方法。

Result: DPTS在低预算下因冷启动瓶颈表现差，但随预算增加有良好扩展性；SSDP能高效找到候选解，但节点合并策略导致前沿枯竭，无法利用额外预算提升性能。两种方法在不同计算条件下呈现相反的局限性。

Conclusion: 固定探索策略和固定剪枝策略均不足以应对不同计算资源条件，有效的科学推理搜索需要能够根据搜索进度和可用资源自适应调整行为的方法。

Abstract: Tree of Thought (ToT) search has become a promising direction for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but deploying these methods in practice raises a question that has received little systematic attention: how do different search strategies behave under varying compute budgets, model sizes, and problem difficulties? In this work, we evaluate two representative ToT methods; DPTS, a Monte Carlo tree search based approach, and SSDP, a semantic deduplication based approach, across two mathematical reasoning benchmarks (Math500 and GSM8K), two model scales (Llama-3B and Llama-8B), and four token budgets (3k--10k). Our analysis reveals that the two methods exhibit limitations that pull in opposite directions. DPTS suffers from a cold-start bottleneck at low budgets: it requires sufficient exploration before its value estimates become reliable, making it a poor fit for resource-constrained settings despite strong scaling behavior at higher budgets. SSDP, on the other hand, reaches candidate solutions efficiently but is prone to frontier depletion; its aggressive node merging permanently discards unexplored paths, leaving it unable to improve regardless of how much budget remains. Together, these findings suggest that neither a fixed exploration strategy nor a fixed pruning strategy is sufficient across compute continuum. We argue that effective search for scientific reasoning agents requires strategies that can adapt their behavior based on search progress and available resources.

</details>


### [312] [The New Associationism: Lessons from Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20600)
*Daniel Rothschild*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现代AI的成功支持了一种温和的联想主义观点：监督学习（基于评价反馈的学习）是当代AI系统的核心机制，从大语言模型到游戏智能体都依赖于此，只是生成反馈信号的工作量不同。这验证了联想主义关于统一、渐进、基于错误驱动的学习机制跨领域运作的理念，反驳了联想机制不足以解释人类认知能力的观点。但深度学习架构远超经典联想主义设想，监督学习只是其中的一个组成部分而非完整的学习理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨现代AI的成功对人类学习机制的理解有何启示，特别是评估联想主义作为人类学习模型的合理性。

Method: 对当代AI系统（大语言模型、游戏智能体等）进行理论分析，论证监督学习是其核心共同机制，并将此与联想主义传统进行对比和整合。

Result: 监督学习广泛存在于各类当代AI系统中，验证了联想主义的核心主张；但深度学习架构超越了经典联想主义，监督学习只是其中的一个组件。

Conclusion: 现代AI支持一种温和的联想主义：既承认监督学习作为统一学习机制的有效性，也承认其需要更复杂的计算架构作为支撑。

Abstract: What can the success of modern AI tell us about how humans learn? This paper argues that taking AI seriously as a model of human learning supports a modest but genuine associationism. The central finding is that supervised learning -- learning driven by evaluative feedback -- underlies a surprisingly wide range of contemporary AI systems, from large language models to game-playing agents, differing primarily in how much work is required to generate the relevant feedback signal. This vindicates associationist ideals of a uniform, gradual, error-driven learning mechanism operating across domains, and defuses the once-influential argument that associationist mechanisms are too limited to account for human cognitive capacities. At the same time, the successes of deep learning depend on computational architectures that go well beyond anything classical associationists envisaged, and supervised learning operates within these as one component rather than a complete account of learning.

</details>


### [313] [Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20615)
*Ylli Prifti*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于AI-SDLC（AI驱动的软件开发生命周期）的领域特定语言（DSL），专门描述人机协作中的责任边界、审批门控和治理约束。该语言区分策略（声明意图）与机制（结构强制），通过验证令牌和能力边界等原语约束过程非确定性。主要成果包括：结构性强制能将系统故障率限制为智能体和验证者成功率的加权乘积（优于行为合规的累积/饱和增长）、定义了2+N团队模式的经典职责分离原则，以及将编排循环的Kleene闭包和协议自反验证作为设计属性自然导出。该工作与MetaGPT、FlowAgent、BPMN扩展和SAGA等框架进行了对比定位，并提供了可行性实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI智能体参与软件开发生命周期时，缺乏一种专门的规约语言来明确表达人类与AI之间的责任边界、审批门控和治理约束。现有方案要么将过程编码在智能体提示中（易漂移），要么针对相邻领域（工作流管理、业务流程），或仅处理碎片化问题（访问控制、审批门控），缺乏统一且形式化的解决方案。

Method: 提出一种领域特定语言（DSL），为AI-SDLC过程提供形式化语法、良构条件、操作语义和执行不变量。核心创新在于区分策略（声明的意图）与机制（结构强制），使实现能够通过验证令牌和能力边界等原语约束过程非确定性。

Result: 三个主要结果：(1) 故障率分析表明结构性强制将系统故障率约束为智能体与验证者成功率的加权乘积，而行为合规方式会导致累积或近饱和增长；(2) 2+N团队模式（两个人类控制角色+N个专业化智能体成员）形式化了AI-SDLC中的经典职责分离原则；(3) 编排循环的Kleene闭包和协议自反验证作为设计属性自然导出，而非特殊构造。

Conclusion: 该工作的新颖性在于特定集成而非单一原语，已提供可行实现证明其可行性，但实证评估留作未来工作。与MetaGPT、FlowAgent、BPMN扩展和SAGA等框架的对比定位表明，该语言填补了AI-SDLC人机协作协议形式化规约的空白。

Abstract: AI agents now participate as first-class team members across the software development lifecycle, yet no specification language exists for expressing the human-agent responsibility boundaries, approval gates, and governance constraints this collaboration requires. Existing approaches encode process in agent prompts (subject to drift), target adjacent domains (workflow management, business processes), or address only fragments (access control, approval gates).
  We propose a domain-specific language for specifying AI-SDLC processes as protocols, with formal syntax, well-formedness conditions, operational semantics, and enforcement invariants. The language distinguishes policy (declared intent) from mechanism (structural enforcement), enabling implementations to bound process non-determinism through primitives such as validation tokens and capability boundaries.
  Three results follow. A failure rate analysis shows that structural enforcement bounds system failure rates at a weighted product of agent and validator rates, while behavioral compliance permits cumulative or near-saturating growth. The 2+N team pattern (two human-in-control roles plus N specialized agent members) formalizes classical Separation of Duties for AI-SDLC. Kleene closure of orchestration loops and reflexive protocol-adherence validation emerge as design properties rather than special-case constructs.
  We position the contribution against multi-agent frameworks (MetaGPT), workflow specification (FlowAgent, BPMN extensions), and capability-based security (SAGA): the novelty lies in the specific integration, not any single primitive. A working implementation demonstrates feasibility; empirical evaluation is future work.

</details>


### [314] [PEAR: Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20621)
*Yang Feng,Ziwei Xu,Xia Hu,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PEAR提出了一种排列等变自适应路由多智能体辩论协议，通过动态重配置通信角色和稀疏拓扑，防止固定拓扑导致的位置偏差和脆弱智能体放大问题，在四个推理基准和六个LLM骨干上显著提升了平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有固定拓扑的多智能体辩论方法存在持续位置偏差、不可靠智能体被放大以及角色分配敏感等问题，限制了辩论系统的鲁棒性和公平性。

Method: 提出PEAR协议，在连续辩论轮次中动态重配置通信角色和稀疏拓扑，基于演化中的智能体状态策略性地切换智能体到角色的分配，实现排列等变稀疏路由。

Result: 在四个推理基准和六个不同LLM骨干上的综合实验表明，PEAR在平均准确率上显著优于最强的辩论基线方法。

Conclusion: PEAR通过排列等变自适应路由有效解决了固定拓扑的位置偏差问题，提升了多智能体辩论的可靠性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate improves the reliability of large language models (LLMs) through iterative peer critiques. However, fixed topologies often introduce persistent positional biases, amplify unreliable agents, and cause high sensitivity to role assignments. We introduce \textit{Permutation-Equivariant Adaptive Routing Multi-Agent Debate (PEAR)}, an inference-time protocol that dynamically reconfigures communication roles and sparse topologies across consecutive debate rounds. By strategically switching agent-to-role assignments based on evolving agent states, PEAR prevents any agent from permanently occupying a privileged network position or distributes influence more evenly across the debate. We theoretically characterize PEAR as an equivariant sparse router: it preserves accuracy under agent relabeling while reducing routing complexity and improving generalization. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across four reasoning benchmarks and six diverse LLM backbones demonstrate PEAR significantly improves average accuracy over the strongest debate baselines. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/PEAR.

</details>


### [315] [Darwin Mobile Agent: A Roadmap for Self-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20622)
*Daniel Beechey,Derek Yuen,Jianheng Liu,Dezhao Luo,Tiantian He,Weilin Luo,Jun Wang,Kun Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出通过系统性地移除人类先验知识，让智能体在与“大世界”的交互中自然涌现通用智能，并以移动GUI作为代理环境，构建了Darwin Mobile Agent基础设施，为自主强化学习奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 创造能在开放环境中展现通用、自适应行为的智能体，遵循“苦涩教训”，认为最有效路径是移除人类先验知识，让智能通过与大世界的交互自然涌现。

Method: 提出移动图形用户界面（GUI）作为“大世界”的实用代理，构建Darwin Mobile Agent开源基础设施，采用异步智能体-环境循环跨并行云手机实例，解决真实世界移动交互中的数据收集瓶颈。概念路线图系统移除任务课程、结果验证和记忆管理三大支柱中的人类先验。

Result: 验证了Darwin基础设施在GUI域策略优化第一阶段所需的稳定性和可扩展性。

Conclusion: 为迈向真正自主、自我进化的GUI智能体建立了实践和理论基础。

Abstract: The goal of artificial intelligence is to create agents capable of general, adaptive behaviour in open-ended environments. Guided by the "Bitter Lesson", we argue that the most effective path toward this goal is to systematically remove human priors and allow intelligence to naturally emerge through interaction with a "Big World" that is orders of magnitude more complex than the agent itself. We propose the mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) as a practical proxy for such a world and introduce Darwin Mobile Agent, an open-source infrastructure designed as a foundation for autonomous reinforcement learning in this domain. This framework addresses the data-collection bottleneck in real-world mobile interactions by using an asynchronous agent-environment loop across parallel cloud-phone instances. We further propose a conceptual roadmap to systematically remove human priors from three fundamental pillars of a self-evolving agent: task curricula, outcome verification, and memory management. We validate that the Darwin infrastructure provides the stability and scalability required for the first stage of this roadmap: policy optimisation in the GUI domain. This work establishes the practical and theoretical foundation necessary to move toward truly autonomous, self-evolving GUI agents.

</details>


### [316] [Path-dependent program induction under resource constraints explains human sequence learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20623)
*Hanqi Zhou,David G. Nagy,Peter Dayan,Charley M. Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了层次化适应文法（HAG），融合率失真理论与程序归纳，从有限认知资源角度解释人们如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可复用的知识。模拟实验表明HAG在率失真权衡和泛化方面优于固定文法与浅层分块方法；在线旋律序列学习实验中，参与者的回忆错误和反应时数据支持层级库模型的解释力，优于所有替代模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在有限认知资源下，人们如何从序列经验中构建抽象、可复用的知识。

Method: 将率失真理论与程序归纳相结合，提出层次化适应文法（HAG），包含局部的任务内库和全局的跨任务库，受记忆与计算约束共同调控。

Result: 模拟实验：HAG在率失真权衡和泛化能力上优于固定文法与浅层分块方法。行为实验：参与者的回忆错误呈现系统性简化，反应时在推断的程序边界处增加；逐试次拟合表明层级库模型在回忆和延续选择上最佳。

Conclusion: 结构化的学习可被理解为有界程序归纳，经验的顺序塑造了学习者未来构建的抽象知识。

Abstract: How do people build abstract, reusable knowledge from sequential experience under bounded cognitive resources? To answer this question, we integrate rate-distortion theory with recent advances in program induction to describe how prior knowledge shapes which future structures are cheap to encode and easy to discover. We formalize this in a hierarchical Adaptor Grammar (HAG) with distinct local (within-task) and global (across-task) libraries, governed jointly by constraints on memory and computation. In simulations, HAG achieves better rate-distortion trade-offs and stronger generalization than fixed grammars or shallow chunking methods. In an online melodic sequence-learning experiment, participants' recall errors reflected systematic simplifications and reaction times increased at inferred program boundaries. Trial-by-trial fits further showed that hierarchical libraries best explained individual differences in both recall and out-of-sample continuation choices, outperforming all alternative models. These findings cast structured learning as bounded program induction in which the order of experience shapes future abstractions a learner builds.

</details>


### [317] [In LLM Reasoning, there is Irrationality on top of Value Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20624)
*Kejiang Qian,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“理性价值风险”概念，形式化定义了LLM在推理时无法最大化对齐价值的效用差距，并通过大量实验验证该风险普遍存在，对齐训练只能降低但无法消除，且对推理策略高度敏感，长推理可提升理性但收益递减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即使LLM在（后）训练中已经很好地对齐了目标价值函数，其在推理时仍可能无法最大化对齐价值，作者旨在形式化和量化这一差距。

Method: 将效用差距数学形式化为理性价值风险（rational value risk），即部署的推理策略与理性策略（在最陡方向上最大化期望效用的响应）之间的效用差异；进一步将理性价值风险的估计误差分解为有限候选、有限提示和不完美验证器三个来源；在多个模型族和基准上开展实验验证。

Result: (1) 理性价值风险普遍存在；(2) 价值对齐可以降低但无法消除该风险；(3) 该风险对推理时策略高度敏感；(4) 更长推理可提升理性但收益递减。

Conclusion: LLM即使在充分对齐后仍存在推理阶段的理性缺陷，需关注推理策略的优化而非仅依赖训练阶段的对齐。

Abstract: Significant progress has been made in aligning LLMs with target value functions. We argue that, even when an LLM has been well aligned in (post-)training, it may still fail to maximise the aligned value in reasoning. We mathematically formalise this gap as rational value risk: the utility discrepancy between a model's deployed reasoning strategy and its rational counterpart, which is defined to be the responses that maximise expected utility in the steepest direction. The estimation error of rational value risk is further decomposed into three components from finite candidates, finite prompts, and imperfect verifiers. Extensive experiments are conducted, covering models Llama-3.1, Qwen-2.5, T{\"}ulu-3 families (7B-72B), GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5, and DeepSeek-V4, and benchmarks UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval, GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, and MathArena. The results validate that (1) rational value risk is widespread; (2) value alignment can reduce, but cannot eliminate, it; (3) the risk is highly sensitive to inference-time reasoning strategy; and (4) longer reasoning improves rationality with diminishing returns. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/LLM-Rationality.

</details>


### [318] [AlphaMemo: Structured Search-Process Memory for Self-Evolving Alpha Mining Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20625)
*Hang Yu,Zifan Zheng,Jeff Z. Pan,Tongliang Liu,Zhiyong Wang,Fengxiang He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AlphaMemo提出了一种具有结构化搜索过程记忆的自进化因子挖掘智能体，通过记录可重用的编辑模式证据、基于置信度的残差记忆和非对称否决控制，在CSI 500和S&P 500上实现了改进的样本外表现和固定预算发现效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在因子挖掘中面临组合搜索空间巨大、噪声非平稳反馈、冗余发现以及过度拟合风险等问题，需要更高效的结构化记忆机制。

Method: AlphaMemo通过抽象语法树差异提取编辑模式，采用置信度门控残差记忆叠加在搜索分类账先验之上，并使用非对称否决控制抑制高置信度失败模式。

Result: 在CSI 500和S&P 500数据集上，AlphaMemo展示了改进的样本外性能和固定预算发现效率，消融实验验证了残差学习、置信度门控、AST差异模式和否决记忆的作用。

Conclusion: 结构化搜索过程记忆能够有效提升因子挖掘智能体的效率和稳健性，代码已开源。

Abstract: LLM agents are promising for alpha mining via combining financial priors, symbolic reasoning, executable factor generation, and feedback-driven refinement. Yet, they face a combinatorial search space, noisy non-stationary feedback, redundant discoveries, and overfitting risks from naively reusing past successes. To address these challenges, we propose AlphaMemo, a self-evolving alpha mining agent with Structured Search-Process Memory. Rather than memorizing only final factors or full trajectories, AlphaMemo records reusable evidence about which edit motifs work or fail under specific parent-factor contexts. It extracts motifs from Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) differences, applies confidence-gated residual memory on top of a search-ledger prior, and uses asymmetric veto control to suppress high-confidence failure patterns. Experiments on CSI 500 and S\&P 500 show improved out-of-sample performance and fixed-budget discovery efficiency, with ablations validating the roles of residual learning, confidence gating, AST-diff motifs, and veto memory. Code is at https://github.com/jarrettyu/AlphaMemo.

</details>


### [319] [Latent Goal Prediction from Language for Model-Based Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20627)
*Samuel Barbeau,Simon Roy,Giovanni Beltrame,Christian Desrosiers,Nicolas Thome*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LAGO通过从语言指令预测隐空间子目标序列并结合动作条件展开，实现了长时域规划中视觉精确性与语言灵活性的统一，避免了复合预测误差和跨模态对齐问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型规划方法存在复合预测误差累积问题，视觉目标虽能提供精确局部梯度但缺乏远距离引导，语言灵活但受限于跨模态对齐噪声或依赖不适合规划的高采样生成模型。

Method: 提出Latent Goal Prediction from Language (LAGO)框架，在同一隐空间中同时预测语言指令对应的中间目标状态序列和动作条件展开轨迹；动态将指令分解为显式预测的局部可解隐子目标，在线更新子目标并在规划中使用软最小轨迹代价。

Result: 在多个环境和规划时域上的评估表明，LAGO避免了先前方法的急剧性能下降，实现了鲁棒且精确的长时域规划。

Conclusion: LAGO通过纯语言实现了兼具视觉目标精确性与文本引导灵活性的长时域规划，弥合了视觉目标与语言控制之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Planning with world models is bottlenecked by compounding prediction errors and the difficulty of defining optimizable goals. Visual targets provide precise local gradients but poor distant guidance, while language is flexible yet limited by noisy cross-modal alignment or dependence on large generative models unsuited for the high-sampling nature of model-based planning. To address these challenges, we introduce Latent Goal Prediction from Language (LAGO), a framework that predicts both sequences of intermediate goal states from language instructions and action-conditioned rollouts, all within the same latent space. Rather than optimizing toward a single global objective, LAGO dynamically decomposes instructions into explicitly predicted, locally tractable latent subgoals. By updating these subgoals online and using a soft minimum trajectory cost during planning, LAGO enables an agent to follow coherent latent trajectories over long horizons. Evaluation across multiple environments planning horizons shows that LAGO avoids the sharp degradation of prior methods. By achieving robust and precise long-horizon planning purely from language, LAGO bridges the precision of visual goals with the flexibility of text-guided control.

</details>


### [320] [Human Decision-Making with AI Assistance under Correlated Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20628)
*Yanru Guan,Naveen Raman,Fei Fang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 当特征存在相关性时，AI辅助决策中的最优策略必须遵循"先探索后承诺"的结构，即在初期提供多样化的测试以帮助人类学习准确的特征系数，然后固定测试集，且探索长度随特征相关性的增强而增加。该问题被证明是NP难的，但可以通过动态规划算法和近似方法实现近最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人类与AI协作决策的场景中（如医生遵循AI推荐的诊断测试），不同特征（测试结果）之间存在相关性，而现有关于独立特征假设下的最优策略（固定重复推荐同一测试集）在特征相关时可能表现极差。因此需要研究在特征相关条件下，如何平衡短期决策质量与长期人类学习效果的最优测试推荐策略。

Method: 理论证明了特征相关时固定策略的次优性，并提出"先探索后承诺"的最优策略结构；通过NP-hard证明计算复杂度；设计了基于动态规划的有限时域精确求解算法，以及基于短时域规划加固定后缀的近似算法。

Result: 证明了特征相关条件下固定策略可能表现任意差；最优策略必须遵循探索-承诺结构；探索长度取决于特征相关程度；计算最优策略是NP难的；动态规划算法可求解有限时域最优策略；近似算法实现近最优性能；实验验证了特征相关性越强，探索阶段越长。

Conclusion: 在特征相关的AI辅助决策中，简单的固定策略不再适用，需要采用"先探索后承诺"的动态策略来平衡短期决策质量和长期学习效果，且探索阶段长度应随特征相关性增强而增加。

Abstract: Humans increasingly make decisions with AI assistance; for example, doctors may follow AI-recommended diagnostic tests and base their diagnoses on the results. A natural question is which tests should AI recommend to balance short-term decision quality and long-term human learning when different features (e.g., test results) are correlated. While prior work establishes that stationary policies that recommend the same tests repeatedly are optimal when features are independent, we prove that feature correlations lead such policies to perform arbitrarily poorly. Instead, we prove that any optimal policy must follow an explore-then-commit structure; initially, the AI should offer diverse tests so humans can learn accurate feature coefficients, then the AI should commit to a single set of tests, with exploration length that depends on the degree of feature correlation. We prove that computing the optimal policy is NP-hard and derive a dynamic programming-based algorithm that finds the optimal policy for finite horizons. We additionally develop an approximation that plans for shorter horizons and appends a stationary suffix, achieving near-optimal performance. Our empirical results complement our theory by showing that stronger feature correlation leads to longer exploration phases.

</details>


### [321] [Harnessing Agent Skills: Architectural Patterns and a Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20631)
*Boming Xia,Liming Zhu,Zhenchang Xing,Qinghua Lu,Dino Sejdinovic,Xiwei Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM智能体中技能制品到技能使用（skill-in-use）的过渡架构责任，提出了10种经验驱动的架构模式（5核心+5支撑），并综合为一个包含供应链、中介、执行控制、证据与反馈四层责任层的参考架构，通过8个系统的跨实例化评估验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能作为可复用的行为知识制品，在静态存储与动态执行之间存在架构责任的鸿沟，缺乏系统化的方法来描述技能从制品到使用（skill-in-use）的过渡、执行约束和证据捕获机制。

Method: 通过经验驱动的方法，归纳出10种架构模式（5核心+5支撑），综合为四层参考架构，并在8个选定的智能体系统中进行跨实例化评估。

Result: 提出了技能驾驭（skill harnessing）的四层参考架构：供应链层、中介层、执行控制层、证据与反馈层；并通过8个系统的实例化验证了该架构的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文的模式和参考架构为分析和诊断不同智能体系统中的技能驾驭责任提供了统一的词汇表和诊断框架。

Abstract: Agent skills externalise reusable agent-facing behavioural knowledge and guidance as persistent artefacts that can be discovered, activated, and interpreted by LLM agents. Although a skill artefact is static at rest, its architectural responsibilities arise in use, when the artefact is selected for a run, bound to context and authority constraints, interpreted by a stochastic agent, and recorded as run evidence. We call this run-specific relation skill-in-use. This paper studies agent skill harnessing: the architectural responsibilities that govern the transition from skill artefacts to skill-in-use, bound the executable consequences associated with skill-in-use, and capture evidence for attribution, verification, repair, and evolution. This paper provides a catalogue of ten empirically grounded architectural patterns (five core, five supporting) for skill harnessing and synthesises them into a reference architecture with four responsibility layers: Supply Chain, Mediation, Execution Control, and Evidence & Feedback. We evaluate the architecture through cross-instantiation across 8 selected systems. The resulting patterns and reference architecture provide a vocabulary and diagnostic frame for analysing skill-harnessing responsibilities across agent systems.

</details>


### [322] [DEMM-Bench: A Cross-Regime Benchmark for Agent-Runtime Governance-Evidence Sufficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20634)
*Oleg Solozobov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DEMM-Bench是首个跨体制的智能体运行时治理证据充分性基准，基于决策证据成熟度模型（DEMM），通过8种证据体制和64个手稿案例评估记录是否足以重构决策级属性。实验表明，trace-present和schema-present基线在75%案例上过度声明，而属性级候选评分器零过度声明，平均属性充分性准确率为56.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体运行时系统产生的各类记录（追踪、账本、策略日志等）无法直接回答特定决策的治理问题，缺乏跨体制评估证据充分性的统一基准。

Method: 基于决策证据成熟度模型（DEMM），通过适配器标准化8种证据体制，提出行为者、权威、行动、策略、决策基础、资源接触、生命周期上下文和验证强度8个属性问题，应用8种确定性退化条件，构建64个手稿案例进行基准测试。

Result: trace-present和schema-present基线在75%案例上过度声明，ledger-present在50%案例上过度声明；属性级候选评分器零过度声明，平均属性充分性准确率为56.25%。

Conclusion: DEMM-Bench为异构智能体运行时证据基板上的决策证据成熟度提供了可复现的评估框架， deposited包包含64案例数据集、构造oracle标签、基线和适配器。

Abstract: Agent-runtime systems emit traces, ledgers, provenance graphs, policy logs, delegation tokens, cache events, and tool-firewall records, but those containers do not necessarily answer governance questions about a specific decision. DEMM-Bench is a cross-regime benchmark for agent-runtime governance-evidence sufficiency, grounded in the Decision Evidence Maturity Model (DEMM): it measures whether records across eight evidence regimes are sufficient to reconstruct decision-level properties rather than merely present. The benchmark normalizes the regimes through adapters, asks property questions over actor, authority, action, policy, decision basis, resource touch, lifecycle context, and verification strength, and applies eight deterministic degradation conditions. Across 64 manuscript cases, trace-present and schema-present baselines overclaim on 75% of cases, ledger-present overclaims on 50%, and the redacted property-level candidate scorer has zero overclaim with 56.25% mean Property Sufficiency Accuracy. The deposited package provides the 64-case dataset, construction-oracle labels, baselines, and adapters, supporting reproducible evaluation of decision-evidence maturity across heterogeneous agent-runtime evidence substrates.

</details>


### [323] [SkillHarness: Harnessing Safe Skills for Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20636)
*Yurun Chen,Biao Yi,Keting Yin,Shengyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillHarness框架，通过安全边界建模和选择性技能复用，在动态环境中实现计算机使用代理的安全技能学习，将技能不安全率降低57.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CUA技能学习方法假设环境静态安全，无法应对对抗交互（如提示注入）和环境动态变化（如弹窗）带来的风险，导致技能学习不安全且执行不稳定。

Method: SkillHarness框架通过多源监督信号构建技能边界来识别安全技能，建立自改进的安全约束，并引入选择性技能复用机制，根据上下文分解任务并选择性激活技能子集。

Result: 实验表明SkillHarness将所学技能的不安全率降低57.1%，并在动态环境变化下持续提升执行稳定性，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过安全约束建模和选择性复用，可有效解决动态环境中CUA技能学习的安全性问题。

Abstract: Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed in dynamic interactive environments, creating a growing need for continual skill learning during interaction. Recent approaches address this challenge by learning reusable skills from successful trajectories. However, these skill learning methods largely assume static and safe environments, overlooking risks from adversarial interactions (e.g., prompt injections) and environmental dynamics (e.g., pop-ups). In dynamic settings, such assumptions can lead to risky skill learning and brittle execution, undermining the reliability of CUAs. This raises the question: how can CUAs learn and use skills safely in dynamic environments? To address this problem, we propose SkillHarness, a framework for safe skill harnessing in dynamic environments. SkillHarness moves beyond static skill abstractions by modeling skill learning and utilization as a safety-constrained interaction process. Specifically, we introduce the skill boundary that leverages multi-source supervision signals to identify safe skills from interaction trajectories, and construct self-improving safety constraints throughout the skill lifecycle. In addition, SkillHarness introduces selective skill reuse, where tasks are guided to decompose according to context and completed through the selective activation of skill subsets. Our experiments demonstrate that SkillHarness significantly reduces the unsafe rate of learned skills by 57.1% and consistently improves execution stability under dynamic environmental changes, outperforming existing baselines.

</details>
